{{Quote|The alien in question is a Rutian Twi'lek, one Nethlek Vaa.|Wilhalm Skrim|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Nethlek Vaa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] informant who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Nethlek Vaa was asking for an outrageous sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in return for the information that he gave to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Wilhalm Skrim]]. Wilhalm was very annoyed by the Twi'lek's persistence and instructed a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to track him down. Nethlek Vaa was seen being guarded by two Rebels until all three were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the spacer.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ThugTwilekMaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Nethlek Vaa]]
Nethlek Vaa was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
